text:
lina: FYI, starting sprint planning for the Conditional Retention project. Need quick alignment on BYOK/KMS model, audit log exposure, and SOC2 acceptance criteria. @aj @sam PTAL :wave:

aj: question — are retention policies applied tenant-wide or can we support per-model TTLs? customers asked for per-tenant first, but some want per-model overrides.

sam: per-tenant is the lowest friction. per-model adds routing + storage metadata. cost estimate: ~2w infra + 1w product.

lina: noted. can we sketch minimal MVP that unblocks enterprise pilots?

aj: MVP proposal: 1) per-tenant retention TTLs (30/90/365), 2) exportable immutable audit stream, 3) BYOK support for keys in KMS (BYOK alpha — manual escrow). No per-model overrides in MVP.

priya: +1 for that scope. important to define audit schema: events, user identity, request/response hashes, model version. Legal wants retention proof for compliance.

legal: we need tamper-evident audit logs and a documented chain-of-custody for evidence exports. Also: SOC2 readiness requires logs for admin actions and key rotation events.

aj: agree. for tamper-evident logs we can ship an append-only export with merkle root per hour. ops-bot will emit hourly snapshots.

ops-bot: automatic message — created export bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/staging/191919. Access: compliance-only.

sam: on BYOK: support two modes in MVP — (A) customer-managed keys in KMS (BYOK) where we never persist plaintext, and (B) platform-managed keys but with stricter access logs. Full HSM escrow and attestation deferred.

lina: acceptance criteria for launch: 1) tenant TTLs enforced end-to-end, 2) audit export ingestion test for 3 customers, 3) BYOK handshake doc + test with one pilot, 4) SOC2 control mapping reviewed by legal. Any objections?

priya: add SLO: export delivery within 24h for evidence package requests. Also need a rollback plan for accidental longer retention.

aj: techncial note: retention enforcement will be post-process TTL tombstone + deletion job per region. We'll need a purge-proof indicator in audit logs. Proposed retention job runs daily at 02:00 UTC.

lina: good. timeline?

sam: rough timeline: scoping + spec this sprint, infra work next sprint, pilot mid-next quarter. Recommend canary with 1 pilot customer in week 3 of infra sprint.

lina: blockers?

legal: confirm KMS provider compatibility matrix (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault). Also require key rotation audit events to be captured.

aj: will prepare matrix. question: do we require external key escrow (customer asks) or can we provide guidance?

lina: MVP: guidance + manual escrow for high-touch deals. Escrow automation is stretch.

priya: UX note — tenant admin needs UI to set TTL and request evidence export. Also UI for BYOK key upload + status.

lina: assign owners: aj = infra & logs, sam = BYOK ops + pilot, priya = UX, legal = compliance acceptance. I'll own ship criteria.

aj: I'll post a short spec doc later today with API sketch. Example retention API snippet:```json
POST /v1/tenants/:id/retention
{
  "ttl_days": 90,
  "policy": "delete-after-ttl",
  "audit_note": "enterprise pilot"
}
```

sam: +1. Also need fallback model for capacity — if purge fails, we should surface incident and pause new writes for the tenant.

lina: make sure cost/infra estimate goes to finance for runway.

ops-bot: automatic message — created ticket: RFC-CR-191919 (retention-RFC), assigned to aj.

priya: can we add a simple export CSV format for legal review in MVP? easier than full evidence package.

legal: CSV ok for initial review but final evidence export must include signed digest and manifest. add to acceptance.

lina: updated acceptance: include signed manifest on export. OK folks — will sync in daily standup and unblock tickets. If no objections by EOD, we'll lock scope. :thumbsup:

aj: no objections. I'll drop the spec link when ready.

sam: works for me.

priya: fine.

legal: fine, taking notes.

ops-bot: automatic message — meeting scheduled: "Conditional Retention kickoff" Tue 10:00 UTC, invite sent to participants.

lina: thanks — closing thread, moving to RFC.
